realm.description: The name of the IPA domain (e.g., 'example.com'). Must match the IPA server domain.

server.description: Hostname or IP of the primary IPA server (e.g., 'ipa.example.com').

create_homedir.description: Whether to automatically create a home directory for IPA users on first login.

prompt_password.description: Custom text to prepend before password prompts (leave blank for default).

dns_lookup_max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth when using DNS to discover IPA servers. Set to 0 to disable DNS SRV lookups.

dns_lookup_realm.description: Whether to use DNS to discover IPA realm (Kerberos realm discovery via SRV records).

dns_discovery.description: Whether to use DNS SRV records to discover IPA domain controllers.

krb5_realm.description: Explicit Kerberos realm name if different from the IPA realm. Defaults to 'realm'.

kdcs.description: List of alternative KDC hostnames for Kerberos authentication (fallbacks).

admin_servers.description: List of alternative admin servers for Kerberos administration (e.g., kadmin operations).

krb5_conf.description: Path to the Kerberos configuration file. Usually /etc/krb5.conf.

ssh_keys.description: Whether to enable retrieval and use of SSH public keys for IPA users.

update_ssh_client_config.description: Whether to automatically update ~/.ssh/config with IPA host keys on login.

add_to_known_hosts.description: Whether to automatically add IPA-managed hosts to ~/.ssh/known_hosts.

configure_sshd.description: Whether to configure the SSH daemon to use SSSD for IPA authentication.

use_sssd.description: Whether to configure the system to use SSSD for user/group lookups and authentication.

ldap_uri.description: Custom LDAP URI for IPA server (e.g., 'ldap://ipa.example.com'). Auto-discovered if omitted.

base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., 'dc=example,dc=com'). Auto-discovered if omitted.

cache_credentials.description: Whether to cache user credentials for offline authentication.

min_id.description: Minimum UID/GID to consider valid (prevents conflicts with local accounts).

enumerate.description: Whether to enumerate all IPA users and groups (may impact performance on large directories).

allow_trusted_domains.description: Whether to allow authentication from trusted Active Directory domains (if configured in IPA).

dns_forwarder.description: DNS forwarder IP for dynamic DNS updates (e.g., '8.8.8.8'). Leave blank to disable.

use_otp.description: Whether to enable one-time password (OTP) authentication for IPA users.
